rationale: Both candidates converge on a similar theme to the one substantive ground-truth design concern (dsocek's push to avoid duplicated hardcoded component lists), with X proposing to read pipeline._dit_modules and Y independently surfacing the same _dit_modules precedent plus two other duplicate lists (registry.py, module_collector.py) — neither captures dsocek's more specific _packed_modules_mapping/naming-conflict angle. Y is more grounded, citing specific greps and line numbers to validate that only SDXL exposes a top-level unet attribute and that sdxl_unet uses real vLLM linear layers, and its findings (parametrize duplicated test, commit an E2E LoRA-diff check, consolidate hardcoded lists) are more concretely actionable than X's softer 'worth a note'/non-blocking framing. X is more concise and its text-encoder no-op point is a reasonable but more speculative addition. Neither review includes a LATENT GAP CHECK section.
